input.subject: COMING SOON | 461 6th St, Park Slope | 2BR $1.75M
input.bodyText:
Hi all,

Wanted to give my broker network a heads up on a coming soon listing before it hits the market Monday.

461 6th St, Park Slope
2 bed / 1 bath
Asking $1,750,000
Classic brownstone floor-through with original details, south-facing garden.

Happy to co-broke. Reach out if you have a qualified buyer and I can arrange a private preview this weekend.

Best,
Jane Smith
Licensed RE Salesperson | Compass
(917) 555-0142
